name: HabitPet
description: A gamified habit tracker where daily consistency powers 2D interactive Pokémon growth (Bulbasaur, Charmander, Squirtle, Pikachu, Gengar, Eevee, Chikorita, Lucario, Mewtwo, Rayquaza), tactile petting, authentic Pokémon multi-stage evolution sequences, dual-mode PvE Gym & PvP Trainer battle arena with elemental counter calculations, pet marriage and offspring, store rewards, and sanctuary progression.
